about: External links for the Advanced page (MASTER_PROMPT §5.8, §8). Link only: never copy their content into the app. level_min/level_max are TBCL levels 1-7 (end of L2 = A1, L3 = A2, L4 = B1, L5 = B2, L6 = C1, L7 = C2). url_template: replace {q} with encodeURIComponent(word or character). tools/check_links.py re-tests every URL and rewrites verified, checked, status (and template_status, final_url, tls, error). An entry with a hold reason stays verified: false whatever its HTTP status.
